-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def mvcc.Sorted (s : List EtcdKv) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise etcdKvLess s

def (sealed) mvcc.kvEncode : EtcdKv → GoString

def mvcc.instInhabitedRev : Inhabited mvcc.Rev :=
  { default := mvcc.instInhabitedRev.default }

def mvcc.Rev.lt_dec : DecidableRel mvcc.Rev.lt :=
  mvcc.Rev.lt_dec._aux_1 x✝¹ x✝

def mvcc.bucketOf (log : mvcc.Log) : List (GoString × GoString) :=
  (List.map (fun p => mvcc.bucketOfRev p.snd (mvcc.stateAt log (p.snd - 1)) p.fst) (List.zipIdx log)).flatten

structure mvcc.Rev : Type where
  main : w64
  sub : w64

theorem mvcc.kiFindGenAux_lt {gens : List mvcc.Gen} {rev : w64} {fuel i : Nat} : mvcc.kiFindGenAux
    gens rev fuel = some i → i < fuel

def mvcc.instDecidableEqRev : DecidableEq mvcc.Rev :=
  mvcc.instDecidableEqRev.decEq

def mvcc.kiGet (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (atRev : w64) : Option (mvcc.Rev × w64 × w64) :=
  match mvcc.kiFindGen ki atRev with
  | none => none
  | some gi =>
    have g := ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty;
    if g.revs = [] then none
    else
      have n := mvcc.genWalk g.revs (mvcc.pAbove atRev);
      if n = -1 then none
      else some (g.revs.getD n.toNat mvcc.Rev.zero, g.created, g.ver - W64 (↑g.revs.length - ↑n.toNat - 1))

def mvcc.kiRestoreTombstone (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  { modified := rev, gens := [{ ver := W64 1, created := W64 0, revs := [rev] }, mvcc.Gen.empty] }

structure mvcc.Ev : Type where
  rev : mvcc.Rev
  change : mvcc.Change

def mvcc.Rev.gt (a b : mvcc.Rev) : Bool :=
  decide (sint.Z b.main < sint.Z a.main) || decide (a.main = b.main) && decide (sint.Z b.sub < sint.Z a.sub)

def mvcc.stateAt (log : mvcc.Log) (r : Nat) : List EtcdKv :=
  mvcc.stateAfter (List.take (r + 1) log)

def mvcc.genWalk (revs : List mvcc.Rev) (p : mvcc.Rev → Bool) : Int :=
  match List.findIdx? (fun r => !p r) revs.reverse with
  | some i => ↑(revs.length - 1 - i)
  | none => -1

def mvcc.instInhabitedGen : Inhabited mvcc.Gen :=
  { default := mvcc.instInhabitedGen.default }

def mvcc.gensOrEmpty (gens : List mvcc.Gen) : List mvcc.Gen :=
  if gens = [] then [mvcc.Gen.empty] else gens

theorem mvcc.set_same {α : Type} {l : List α} {i : Nat} {gm : α} (h : l[i]? = some gm) : l.set i gm
    = l

structure mvcc.KeyIndex : Type where
  modified : mvcc.Rev
  gens : List mvcc.Gen

def mvcc.LogWf (log : mvcc.Log) : Prop :=
  log[0]? = some [] ∧
    ∀ (r : Nat) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (i : Nat) (k : GoString),
      log[r]? = some cs →
        cs[i]? = some (mvcc.Change.del k) →
          (mvcc.findKey k (mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑r) (mvcc.stateAt log (r - 1)) (List.take i cs))).isSome = true

def mvcc.Gen.empty : mvcc.Gen :=
  { ver := W64 0, created := W64 0, revs := [] }

def mvcc.kiLastEmpty (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Bool :=
  decide ((ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs = [])

def mvcc.Change.key : mvcc.Change → GoString :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.Change.put k value lease => k
  | mvcc.Change.del k => k

theorem mvcc.getElem?_last {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (l : List α) (h : l ≠ []) : l[l.length - 1]? =
    some (l.getLastD default)

def mvcc.kiIsEmpty (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Bool :=
  match ki.gens with
  | [g] => decide (g.revs = [])
  | x => false

theorem mvcc.Rev.gt_of_main_eq {a b : mvcc.Rev} (h : a.main = b.main) : a.gt b = decide (sint.Z
    b.sub < sint.Z a.sub)

def mvcc.pAbove (atRev : w64) (r : mvcc.Rev) : Bool :=
  decide (sint.Z atRev < sint.Z r.main)

theorem mvcc.kiFindGenAux_next {gens : List mvcc.Gen} {rev : w64} {cg : Nat} (hne : (gens.getD cg
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []) (hnot : ¬(cg ≠ gens.length - 1 ∧ sint.Z ((gens.getD cg
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.getLastD mvcc.Rev.zero).main ≤ sint.Z rev)) (hnf : ¬sint.Z ((gens.getD cg
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.headD mvcc.Rev.zero).main ≤ sint.Z rev) : mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens rev (cg +
    1) = mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens rev cg

def mvcc.idxApply (idx : mvcc.IndexM) (ev : mvcc.Ev) : mvcc.IndexM :=
  if ev.tomb = true then mvcc.idxTombstone idx ev.key ev.rev else mvcc.idxPut idx ev.key ev.rev

def mvcc.findKey (k : GoString) (s : List EtcdKv) : Option EtcdKv :=
  List.find? (fun v => decide (v.key = k)) s

def mvcc.kiPut (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  have gens := if ki.gens = [] then [mvcc.Gen.empty] else ki.gens;
  { modified := rev, gens := gens.dropLast ++ [mvcc.genPut (gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty) rev] }

def mvcc.instInhabitedKeyIndex : Inhabited mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  { default := mvcc.instInhabitedKeyIndex.default }

theorem mvcc.kiFindGenAux_skip {gens : List mvcc.Gen} {rev : w64} {cg : Nat} (h : (gens.getD cg
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs = []) : mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens rev (cg + 1) = mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens rev cg

theorem mvcc.kiFindGenAux_found {gens : List mvcc.Gen} {rev : w64} {cg : Nat} (hne : (gens.getD cg
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []) (hnot : ¬(cg ≠ gens.length - 1 ∧ sint.Z ((gens.getD cg
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.getLastD mvcc.Rev.zero).main ≤ sint.Z rev)) (hf : sint.Z ((gens.getD cg
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.headD mvcc.Rev.zero).main ≤ sint.Z rev) : mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens rev (cg +
    1) = some cg

def mvcc.idxLess_dec : DecidableRel mvcc.idxLess :=
  go.goStringLt_dec a.fst b.fst

theorem mvcc.kiPut_modified (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : (mvcc.kiPut ki rev).modified =
    rev

theorem mvcc.kiPut_gens (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : (mvcc.kiPut ki rev).gens =
    (mvcc.gensOrEmpty ki.gens).dropLast ++ [mvcc.genPut ((mvcc.gensOrEmpty ki.gens).getLastD
    mvcc.Gen.empty) rev]

def mvcc.Log : Type :=
  List (List mvcc.Change)

theorem mvcc.genWalk_range (revs : List mvcc.Rev) (p : mvcc.Rev → Bool) : -1 ≤ mvcc.genWalk revs p ∧
    mvcc.genWalk revs p < ↑revs.length

def mvcc.kiFindGen (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (rev : w64) : Option Nat :=
  mvcc.kiFindGenAux ki.gens rev ki.gens.length

inductive mvcc.Change : Type
  | mvcc.Change.put (key value : GoString) (lease : w64) : mvcc.Change
  | mvcc.Change.del (key : GoString) : mvcc.Change

def mvcc.kiRestore (created : w64) (modified : mvcc.Rev) (ver : w64) : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  { modified := modified, gens := [{ ver := ver, created := created, revs := [modified] }] }

def mvcc.indexOf (evs : List mvcc.Ev) : mvcc.IndexM :=
  List.foldl mvcc.idxApply [] evs

theorem mvcc.Rev.gt_false_of_main_lt {a b : mvcc.Rev} (h : sint.Z a.main < sint.Z b.main) : a.gt b =
    false

def mvcc.kiFindGenAux (gens : List mvcc.Gen) (rev : w64) : Nat → Option Nat :=
  Nat.brecOn x✝ (mvcc.kiFindGenAux._f gens rev)

def mvcc.Rev.zero : mvcc.Rev :=
  { main := W64 0, sub := W64 0 }

def mvcc.evsOf (log : mvcc.Log) : List mvcc.Ev :=
  (List.map (fun p => mvcc.evsOfRev p.snd p.fst) (List.zipIdx log)).flatten

def mvcc.Ev.key (e : mvcc.Ev) : GoString :=
  e.change.key

def mvcc.Rev.lt (a b : mvcc.Rev) : Prop :=
  sint.Z a.main < sint.Z b.main ∨ a.main = b.main ∧ sint.Z a.sub < sint.Z b.sub

def mvcc.revBytes (rev : mvcc.Rev) (tomb : Bool) : GoString :=
  u64Be rev.main ++ [W8 95] ++ u64Be rev.sub ++ if tomb = true then [W8 116] else []

def mvcc.idxGet (idx : mvcc.IndexM) (k : GoString) : Option mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  Option.map Prod.snd (btFind mvcc.idxLess (k, mvcc.KeyIndex.fresh) idx)

def mvcc.stateAfter (log : mvcc.Log) : List EtcdKv :=
  List.foldl (fun s p => mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑p.snd) s p.fst) [] (List.zipIdx log)

theorem mvcc.set_last {α : Type} (l : List α) (x : α) (h : l ≠ []) : l.set (l.length - 1) x =
    l.dropLast ++ [x]

def mvcc.instInhabitedGen.default : mvcc.Gen :=
  { ver := default, created := default, revs := default }

theorem mvcc.kiFindGenAux_tomb {gens : List mvcc.Gen} {rev : w64} {cg : Nat} (hne : (gens.getD cg
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []) (hcg : cg ≠ gens.length - 1) (ht : sint.Z ((gens.getD cg
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.getLastD mvcc.Rev.zero).main ≤ sint.Z rev) : mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens rev (cg
    + 1) = none

def mvcc.applyChange (r : w64) (s : List EtcdKv) : mvcc.Change → List EtcdKv :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.Change.put k v l => putKv r k v l s
  | mvcc.Change.del k => List.filter (fun x => !decide (x.key = k)) s

def mvcc.kiTombstone (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  have ki' := mvcc.kiPut ki rev;
  { modified := ki'.modified, gens := ki'.gens ++ [mvcc.Gen.empty] }

def mvcc.idxLess (a b : GoString × mvcc.KeyIndex) : Prop :=
  go.GoStringLt a.fst b.fst

theorem mvcc.revBytes_length (rev : mvcc.Rev) (tomb : Bool) : List.length (mvcc.revBytes rev tomb) =
    if tomb = true then 18 else 17

def mvcc.KeyIndex.fresh : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  { modified := mvcc.Rev.zero, gens := [] }

def mvcc.IndexM : Type :=
  List (GoString × mvcc.KeyIndex)

def mvcc.instInhabitedRev.default : mvcc.Rev :=
  { main := default, sub := default }

theorem mvcc.Rev.gt_iff (a b : mvcc.Rev) : a.gt b = true ↔ b.lt a

def mvcc.idxPut (idx : mvcc.IndexM) (k : GoString) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.IndexM :=
  match mvcc.idxGet idx k with
  | some ki => btInsert mvcc.idxLess (k, mvcc.kiPut ki rev) idx
  | none => btInsert mvcc.idxLess (k, mvcc.kiPut mvcc.KeyIndex.fresh rev) idx

def mvcc.Change.isDel : mvcc.Change → Bool :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.Change.put key value lease => false
  | mvcc.Change.del key => true

theorem mvcc.genWalk_eq_some {revs : List mvcc.Rev} {p : mvcc.Rev → Bool} (j : Nat) (hj : j <
    revs.length) (hfail : p revs[j] = false) (hpass : ∀ (k : Nat) (hk : k < revs.length), j < k → p
    revs[k] = true) : mvcc.genWalk revs p = ↑j

def mvcc.instInhabitedKeyIndex.default : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  { modified := default, gens := default }

theorem mvcc.genWalk_eq_none {revs : List mvcc.Rev} {p : mvcc.Rev → Bool} (h : ∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), r ∈
    revs → p r = true) : mvcc.genWalk revs p = -1

structure mvcc.Gen : Type where
  ver : w64
  created : w64
  revs : List mvcc.Rev

def mvcc.bucketOfRev (r : Nat) (before : List EtcdKv) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : List (GoString ×
    GoString) :=
  List.filterMap
    (fun p =>
      Option.map (fun kv => (mvcc.revBytes { main := W64 ↑r, sub := W64 ↑p.snd } p.fst.isDel, mvcc.kvEncode kv))
        (mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑r) before cs p.snd))
    cs.zipIdx

def mvcc.instDecidableEqRev.decEq (x✝ x✝¹ : mvcc.Rev) : Decidable (x✝ = x✝¹) :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | { main := a, sub := a_1 }, { main := b, sub := b_1 } =>
    if h : a = b then h ▸ if h : a_1 = b_1 then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯ else isFalse ⋯

theorem mvcc.gensOrEmpty_ne_nil (gens : List mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.gensOrEmpty gens ≠ []

def mvcc.changeKv (r : w64) (before : List EtcdKv) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (i : Nat) : Option EtcdKv
    :=
  match cs[i]? with
  | some (mvcc.Change.put k value lease) => mvcc.findKey k (mvcc.applyChanges r before (List.take (i + 1) cs))
  | some (mvcc.Change.del k) => some (zeroKv k)
  | none => none

theorem mvcc.kiFindGenAux.eq_def (gens : List mvcc.Gen) (rev : w64) (x✝ : Nat) : mvcc.kiFindGenAux
    gens rev x✝ = match x✝ with | 0 => none | cg.succ => have g := gens.getD cg mvcc.Gen.empty; if
    g.revs = [] then mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens rev cg else if cg ≠ gens.length - 1 ∧ sint.Z
    (g.revs.getLastD mvcc.Rev.zero).main ≤ sint.Z rev then none else if sint.Z (g.revs.headD
    mvcc.Rev.zero).main ≤ sint.Z rev then some cg else mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens rev cg

theorem mvcc.kiFindGenAux_succ (gens : List mvcc.Gen) (rev : w64) (cg : Nat) : mvcc.kiFindGenAux
    gens rev (cg + 1) = have g := gens.getD cg mvcc.Gen.empty; if g.revs = [] then mvcc.kiFindGenAux
    gens rev cg else if cg ≠ gens.length - 1 ∧ sint.Z (g.revs.getLastD mvcc.Rev.zero).main ≤ sint.Z
    rev then none else if sint.Z (g.revs.headD mvcc.Rev.zero).main ≤ sint.Z rev then some cg else
    mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens rev cg

def mvcc.idxTombstone (idx : mvcc.IndexM) (k : GoString) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.IndexM :=
  match mvcc.idxGet idx k with
  | some ki => if mvcc.kiLastEmpty ki = true then idx else btInsert mvcc.idxLess (k, mvcc.kiTombstone ki rev) idx
  | none => idx

def mvcc.bucketMap (log : mvcc.Log) : GMap GoString GoString :=
  List.foldl (fun m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) GMap.empty (mvcc.bucketOf log)

def mvcc.Ev.tomb (e : mvcc.Ev) : Bool :=
  e.change.isDel

def mvcc.genPut (g : mvcc.Gen) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.Gen :=
  { ver := g.ver + W64 1, created := if g.revs = [] then rev.main else g.created, revs := g.revs ++ [rev] }

theorem mvcc.kiFindGen_lt {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} {rev : w64} {i : Nat} (h : mvcc.kiFindGen ki rev =
    some i) : i < ki.gens.length

def mvcc.evsOfRev (r : Nat) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : List mvcc.Ev :=
  List.map (fun p => { rev := { main := W64 ↑r, sub := W64 ↑p.snd }, change := p.fst }) cs.zipIdx

def mvcc.applyChanges (r : w64) (s : List EtcdKv) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : List EtcdKv :=
  List.foldl (mvcc.applyChange r) s cs

theorem mvcc.Rev.gt_true_of_main_lt {a b : mvcc.Rev} (h : sint.Z b.main < sint.Z a.main) : a.gt b =
    true
